comment: Ready-made looks the launcher offers. Each preset lists only what it changes from the shipped CoAVolFog.ini; 'ultra' is the shipped file itself. Keys must exist in schema.json (scripts/settings_schema.py --check verifies it).

presets.label: Performance
presets.help: For modest PCs and laptops: the fog at quarter resolution, fewer lamps, no lamp shadows and the client's own view distance.

presets.label: Balanced
presets.help: Most of the look at a lower cost: the fog at half resolution, fewer lamps and a shorter view distance.

presets.label: Ultra
presets.help: Everything on: the full fog, lamps, shadows, water and the longest view distance. The look the screenshots were taken with.
